answer: Identity bonds that decay like an ember cooling in the tundra stop sybil farming at the root. Each agent locks a 2 POA bond that loses 0.2 POA per epoch of inactivity, and it only unlocks after the agent threads real work through verified counterparties for a month. An attacker spinning up 1000 fake identities must prepay 2000 POA and bleed 200 POA every epoch in decay, while an honest agent pays one 2 POA bond and gets it back in full.
